summary: Lucas GC Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that, at an extraordinary general meeting held October 2, 2026, shareholders approved a share capital restructuring, a notice-period amendment to Article 35.4(a), and an amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. Authorized capital changes from US$500,000 divided into 20,000,000 shares of US$0.025 par value to US$500,000 divided into 50,000,000,000 shares of US$0.00001 par value, split between Class A and Class B. The restructuring takes effect on Nasdaq at the open on October 7, 2026; no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are stated.
